name: ElevenLabs
tagline: AI voice synthesis and speech generation API for natural-sounding text-to-speech
description: ElevenLabs provides a production-ready API for text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, voice cloning, and conversational AI. Developers authenticate with an API key and call REST endpoints under api.elevenlabs.io to generate audio, manage voices, and build voice-enabled applications.

auth.details: API key via xi-api-key header; create keys in the ElevenLabs dashboard after account signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 10,000 credits/month shared across products (TTS, STT, music, SFX, etc.); TTS typically ~0.5–1 credit per character by model (e.g. Multilingual v2 = 1 credit/char; Flash/Turbo API often 0.5); commercial licensing requires a paid plan
pricing.paid_plans: Starter, Creator, Pro, Scale, and Business plans with higher character quotas and concurrency

rate_limits: Plan-based concurrency and character quotas; exact published limits vary by tier

example.response_snippet: Binary audio/mpeg stream (or JSON error with detail message on failure)

use_cases: convert text to natural speech audio for apps
clone a voice from audio samples
stream TTS for real-time voice agents
transcribe or process speech with speech-to-speech
